ball.definition: A round toy. You throw it, catch it and kick it.

gd_attack.definition: The move that turns on the person who holds the account, so that the person becomes the problem.
gd_attack.example: The attack moved the talk from the handover to her tone.

glide.definition: To travel through the air without flapping your wings. The wind holds you up.
glide.example: She slid over the wall. She was gliding.

mon_store_of_value.definition: The job money does when it keeps its value over time, so a payment can be made today for something received later.
mon_store_of_value.example: The balance in the account is a store of value for the bill that arrives next month.

soil.definition: The soft earth where plants grow. It holds water and food for the roots.
soil.example: The seed fell into the soft brown soil.

stakeholder.definition: Any person or group affected by a decision, inside or outside the organisation.
stakeholder.example: I had to keep three stakeholders updated without overloading them.
